claims.statement: Elastic documents Personal API keys created inside a Serverless project, used to call the project Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs on behalf of a user.

sources.supports: Personal API keys, that you can create to allow external services to access your serverless project, including the Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs, on behalf of a user.

claims.statement: Elastic documents that after creation the encoded API key is copied and sent as an Authorization: ApiKey header value to the Elasticsearch HTTP API.

sources.supports: Once created, you can copy the encoded API key and use it to send requests to the Elasticsearch HTTP API: -H "Authorization: ApiKey ${API_KEY}"

openQuestions.question: Whether a Serverless project key is the same credential family as the Elasticsearch user API key (same encoded representation, same issuance API) or a distinct one is not established; the documentation describes them on separate pages and the Serverless response type shares the encoded field with the stack one.
This candidate is recorded from the claims above only; format, variants, history and benign siblings have not been researched.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate existence established from Elastic documentation source files read on 2026-10-04; the family is not researched beyond what the claims state.
